name: hmac_sign
description: Sign a payload with HMAC-SHA256, using the signing_key from the step's environment.

payload.description: Exact bytes to sign. Signed verbatim, with no trimming or normalising.

output_schema.description: Lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256 digest, with no trailing newline so it can be templated inline.

exit_codes.2: invalid input (stdin was not a JSON object, or payload is missing)
exit_codes.5: signing_key is not in the environment (the step did not declare it in 'secrets')
